findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
6-301.12 There wasn't any paper towels available at the hand-sink in the back storage area. Discussed with PIC and paper towels were provided. PIC mentioned that paper towels dispenser was broken. Ensure that the necessary repairs is done on the paper towel dispenser in the area mentioned. Be sure that paper towels are available at every hand-sink  to ensure hands are getting washed properly.  

Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; or (C) A heated-air hand drying device; or (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114 There was no sani bucket available at the beginning of the inspection. PIC was made aware of the sani bucket being empty and a new sani bucket was made.  Ensure that there is sanitizer in the sani bucket at all times to ensure proper sanitary cleaning of food-contact surfaces.

(E) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (E) If a chemical SANITIZER other than chlorine, iodine, or a quaternary ammonium compound is used, it shall be applied in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: There wasn’t any soap available at the front of the house hand-sink. Discussed with PIC and hand soap was provided. Be sure that soap is available at every hand-sink to ensure that’s hands are getting washed properly.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: An insect glue trap was stored in close proximity of clean dishes in the dish room. Discussed and showed to PIC. Ensure that glue traps are never stored near clean dishes to avoid contaminating food.
findings.citation_text: 6-202.13 Insect Control Devices, Design and Installation. (A) Insect control devices that are used to electrocute or stun flying insects shall be designed to retain the insect within the device. (B) Insect control devices shall be installed so that: (1) The devices are not located over a FOOD preparation area; and (2) Dead insects and insect fragments are prevented from being impelled onto or falling on exposed FOOD; clean EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, and LINENS; and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: The prep table in the back of the house is stored underneath vent covers that are significantly covered in dust. Discussed and shown to PIC. Ensure that vent covers are frequently cleaned to prevent buildup and contaminating food items during preparation.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.14 Food Preparation. During preparation, unPACKAGED FOOD shall be protected from environmental sources of contamination.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment:
The following areas are in disrepair:
- cabinet doors are missing from the cabinet space across from the serving freezers (in front of house) - cabinets store single service items
- the leg of the prep table in the back of the house is broken and is wrapped in duck tape - causing the table to be unleveled

Ensure that pieces of equipment are repaired.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The following nonfood contact surfaces were observed soiled:
- there was a buildup of mold along the back of the triple sink in the BOH - clean mold and re-caulk sink to wall
- several nonfood contact surfaces such as counter tops, inside of cabinets, sides of equipment, etc. were observed with a buildup up food residue and other debris

Ensure that these area are cleaned/sanitized frequently to prevent buildup and the presence of mold.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: There was a leak coming from the faucet of the triple sink. Discussed and shown to PIC. Ensure that the triple sink’s faucet is repaired and is in leak free condition.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(B) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following areas are in need of repair and cleaning:
- there are missing ceiling tiles above single service items in the storage room
- overall, floors, walls, and ceilings throughout the front and back of house are in need of a deep cleaning. Splatter and debris are observed on surfaces. 
Ensure that physical facilities are maintained and cleaned as frequent as necessary.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed wet mop head stored in basin of mop sink. Discussed with PIC and mop head was turned upside down. Ensure that wet mop heads are stored in a manner that allows for them to properly air dry.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
There wasn’t a Certified Food Protection Manager present during the inspection. Ensure that a CFPM is available during all hours of operation. 

2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
Observed the faucet of the triple sink to be leaking. There was water leaking into the basin of the sink from the faucet area. Ensure that faucets are maintained and are in leak free condition. 

5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
The employees working at the time of the inspection were not food handler certified. Ensure that all employees are food handler certified if they handle food. 

410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.
